races.name: Construction Day 14th Oct Handicap

runners_data.name: High Chieftain
runners_data.note: Prominent runner returning from 93-day break with time to improve but needs to prove he handles the step up in trip
runners_data.comment: Fourth of five on handicap debut in Februray (8.6f, AW); cheekpieces now added; unexposed
runners_data.spotlight: No immediate improvement for the switch to handicaps and a longer trip (8.6f) when fourth of five at Wolverhampton in February; still has time to do better and cheekpieces could give him a lift.

runners_data.name: Sweet Mabel

races.paceDynamic: Spacewoman and Space Moon will likely contest the early lead, with High Chieftain sitting prominently behind them. The moderate pace they set should allow the hold-up horses Legacy Rock, Daretobedifferent, Blue Celestial and Sweet Mabel to get into contention. At 1m½f on good ground with limited early pace pressure, this race strongly favours horses that can close from off the pace and finish well.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is steady and the race develops into a sprint finish
scenarios.body: Legacy Rock and Daretobedifferent can use their proven closing kicks to sweep past tiring leaders. The longer trip and good ground conditions perfectly suit horses that need time to wind up.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent runners prevail
scenarios.trigger: If High Chieftain can secure ideal positioning behind the leaders without being squeezed for room
scenarios.body: His prominent style allows him to track the pace and strike when the hold-up horses are still making ground. Space Moon could also benefit if she can sit closer than usual and avoid traffic problems.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front runner steals it
scenarios.trigger: If Spacewoman gets an uncontested lead and sets modest fractions throughout
scenarios.body: She can kick clear entering the straight before the closers fully engage their finishing gears. The 35-day break could have freshened her up enough to finally deliver on her earlier promise.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a muddling affair with several horses still in contention at the furlong pole
scenarios.body: Sweet Mabel could find significant improvement returning to turf after a 134-day break. Blue Celestial's recent Kempton form might translate better to this longer turf test than expected.

watchPoints.text: Sweet Mabel's 134-day absence combined with her known finishing problems makes her a significant risk at this trip
Spacewoman could set uncontested fractions if Space Moon doesn't go with her early, creating a tactical disadvantage for closers
Legacy Rock's 8-day turnaround after his comfortable Windsor win could either aid or hinder his hat-trick attempt
High Chieftain's first run beyond 7 furlongs needs monitoring to see if he stays the extended trip
Space Moon and Spacewoman both need to avoid getting into an early speed duel that could compromise both their chances

races.name: When You Wish Upon A Star Restricted Maiden Stakes (Bands B, C And D) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Sunnie Jim

runners_data.spotlight: 50-1, slowly away and always behind on his Southwell debut ten days ago (1m).

runners_data.name: Symphony's Song
runners_data.note: Prominent style could see her involved early but class looks insufficient against these

races.paceDynamic: Dark Whisper and Lucky Camino will set a sustainable early pace as the only prominent runners, with Symphony's Song potentially joining them early. The hold-up quartet of Leonardo Blu, Turton, Sunnie Jim, and newcomer Livemore will track behind in a strung-out field. With just two genuine pace-setters over 1m4f on good ground, the tempo will be manageable rather than cutthroat. This shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can position close to the pace without pressure, as the hold-up horses face a difficult task from too far back in a small, slowly-run field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Dark Whisper and Lucky Camino get an uncontested lead and control the fractions
scenarios.body: The two class acts dictate terms up front and have too much quality for the hold-up brigade to reel in. Their superior form figures and tactical advantage prove decisive in a steadily-run race.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is even slower than expected and one closer gets a perfect stalking trip
scenarios.body: Leonardo Blu or Livemore benefit from patient rides and superior finishing kicks when the leaders tire. The good ground and extended trip play into the hands of horses with stamina reserves.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Newcomer Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Livemore shows immediate ability on debut and gets a dream run from off the pace
scenarios.body: The well-bred debutant from the Kent stable produces a taking performance with natural improvement. His unknown quantity status masks genuine talent that emerges under a confident ride.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Weak Pace Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If Symphony's Song or another outsider forces a stronger gallop than expected early
scenarios.body: The increased tempo plays havoc with the favourites' tactics and opens up opportunities for each-way shocks. Stamina becomes the deciding factor as class horses empty out in the final furlong.

watchPoints.text: Dark Whisper and Lucky Camino getting an uncontested lead could make this a procession given their class edge
Livemore's market moves as the unknown debutant could spring a surprise if showing natural ability
Early pace development crucial as slow tempo will make life very difficult for the hold-up horses
Symphony's Song forcing the pace harder than expected could change the entire complexion
Ground conditions remaining genuinely good rather than riding softer will suit the prominent pair

races.name: Wildwest Beer Festival 4th July Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Wateen
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning after 273 days off, previously showed ability but fitness concerns after nearly nine-month break
runners_data.comment: Listed third at 2; not obviously well treated but could improve for the move to R Cowell
runners_data.spotlight: Formerly trained by Alice Haynes; highly tried as a 2yo after winning a 5f Lingfield maiden (good ground), running her best race when third of seven in a Listed race at Deauville last August (5f, good to soft); not obviously well treated for her handicap debut but she has joined a stable known for their sprinters and looks worth a market check.

races.paceDynamic: Ruby's Profit and Sugar Hill Babe will fight for the early lead, both confirmed front runners who have shown pace at this trip. With only seven runners and two natural pace-setters, the early gallop should be genuine but not suicidal, particularly as both leaders have tactical speed rather than being one-paced tearaways. The pace will be honest throughout the 5f journey, creating a race where the prominent runners and those with tactical speed will be favoured over pure hold-up horses. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and those with early pace who can position close to the leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuine but not excessive between the two leaders
scenarios.body: The early pace will be honest enough to set up the race for horses tracking just behind, allowing them to pounce in the final furlong when the leaders tire. Horses like Sugar Hill Babe or Emerald Harmony, who can sit prominent and finish, will benefit from this tactical positioning.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If one of the pace-setters can steal a march and get an uncontested lead
scenarios.body: Ruby's Profit or Sugar Hill Babe will dictate terms from the front, with the other pace-setter either settling or being outpaced early. The leader will have enough left to repel late challenges from the hold-up horses who face a difficult task from off the pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong enough to compromise both front runners significantly
scenarios.body: The dual between Ruby's Profit and Sugar Hill Babe will go quick enough to set up a closer, with Time To Take Off, Novelette or Wateen sweeping through from the back. The pace collapse will favour horses with a devastating turn of foot from off the speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If both pace-setters go too fast and burn out before halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the 2f pole with all runners having a chance, favouring those with the best finishing kick regardless of position. This chaotic finish will suit any horse with natural speed who can quicken when it matters most.

watchPoints.text: Ruby's Profit and Sugar Hill Babe fighting for the lead early, if they go too fast both could be vulnerable to closers
Novelette and Wateen both returning from very long breaks of 275 and 273 days respectively, fitness highly questionable
Time To Take Off dropping back into handicap company after novice races, weight and class relief could spark improvement
Emerald Harmony's quick turnaround of 15 days may indicate trainer confidence after her good Newcastle second
Chicory stepping back from 6f to 5f having raced exclusively at the longer trip, may lack the natural speed for this contest

races.paceDynamic: Little Peter and In The Post will contest the early lead in this small field, with Two Plus Two also capable of pressing forward if the pace is modest. The dual front-runners should ensure an honest gallop over this extended trip, though neither is particularly keen which could allow the pace to become steady rather than fierce. With four of seven runners being hold-up horses (Bulldog Spirit, Tazaman, Tupero, Two Plus Two), they'll need the leaders to go fast enough to set up a finish. This race shape marginally favours horses that can sit handy and pounce, as the pace may not be strong enough to completely exhaust the leaders.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Honest Pace Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Little Peter and In The Post maintain a solid gallop throughout.
scenarios.body: The steady tempo allows the class hold-up horses to close strongly in the final furlong. Tupero and Tazaman can unleash their finishing kicks from ideal positions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Modest Tempo Suits Handymen
scenarios.trigger: If both leaders go too steady and compromise the finish.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows prominent runners and tactical speed horses to control proceedings. Diamond Bay and Two Plus Two can position perfectly to strike when it matters.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Early Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Little Peter or In The Post get competitive and force a genuine pace.
scenarios.body: The honest tempo stretches the field and sets up a true staying test. Fresh horses with proven stamina can pick up the pieces as others tire.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Two Plus Two or In The Post gets an uncontested lead and steals a march.
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run on the field and maintains just enough advantage to hold on. Recent winners with confidence can exploit tactical positioning.

watchPoints.text: Little Peter's fitness after 166-day layoff could see him fold quickly if he contests the early pace too keenly.
Two Plus Two's ability to adapt tactics from his usual hold-up style if the early pace becomes too slow.
Tupero's chances rely heavily on Little Peter and In The Post providing sufficient early pace to set up his closing kick.
In The Post may need to lead throughout if Little Peter doesn't show early speed, which could compromise his finishing kick.
Diamond Bay's recent poor form suggests he may struggle to match these better handicappers despite favorable weight.

runners_data.spotlight: Now 311 over C&D after beating four rivals with ease a month ago (good); this 5lb higher mark has proved troublesome in the past but those runs were elsewhere.

runners_data.name: Bearin Up
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner stepping up in trip after Newmarket win but needs strong pace to be effective
runners_data.comment: Cosy winner of a Newmarket Class 5; raised 5lb but this longer trip might bring her on
runners_data.spotlight: Her second win in ten starts when a cosy winner at Newmarket (1m, good); 5lb higher and that was a Class 5 event, but this longer trip might eke out further improvement.

runners_data.name: Dunkeld Dreamer
runners_data.note: In-form prominent runner who was runner-up over course and distance showing consistency
runners_data.comment: Beaten 8l into second at Hamilton (1m1f, good); the winner looked way ahead of her mark
runners_data.spotlight: In form and although beaten 8l into second at Hamilton (1m1f, good) the winner looked way ahead of her mark; has finished runner-up over C&D and can run well again.

races.paceDynamic: Lady Dora Mae will set the pace from the front with several prominent runners including Silken Bay, Sharp Romance, Shady Bay, and Dunkeld Dreamer tracking close behind, creating a compact leading group. With only Galaxy Star and Bearin Up held up, there won't be significant early pressure on Lady Dora Mae, allowing her to dictate a steady gallop through the middle stages. The pace will intensify from the 3-furlong pole as the prominent runners close in, setting up a sustained drive to the line. This moderate early pace followed by a strong finish clearly favours prominent runners who can position close to the pace and have the stamina to sustain their effort over the final 3 furlongs.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent runners dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Dora Mae sets sustainable fractions and the prominent group stay within striking distance
scenarios.body: The moderate pace allows trackers like Sharp Romance, Shady Bay and Dunkeld Dreamer to travel smoothly before unleashing strong finishes. Hold-up horses Galaxy Star and Bearin Up struggle to make up ground as the pace quickens late.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runner steals march
scenarios.trigger: If Lady Dora Mae gets easy fractions and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: Her early Windsor win shows she can quicken off steady pace, and with light weight she could prove hard to peg back. The prominent runners react too late as she builds an unassailable lead.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up horses surge late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes competitive early with the prominent group going too fast
scenarios.body: Galaxy Star and Bearin Up benefit from a strong gallop that sets up their closing kicks over this stamina-testing trip. The early pace-setters weaken in the final furlong as the hold-up pair finish fastest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Course specialist prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Shady Bay's proven course form becomes decisive in a tight finish
scenarios.body: Her easy C&D win last time demonstrates superior track knowledge despite the 5lb rise in the weights. The combination of course experience and good recent form proves enough to edge a competitive finish.

watchPoints.text: Watch if Lady Dora Mae gets uncontested lead early as her light weight and recent form could prove decisive
Monitor how quickly Galaxy Star can get into contention from her likely back position in small field
Sharp Romance's inexperience could be exposed if drawn into early pace battle with prominent group
Bearin Up needs strong gallop to be effective but may struggle if Lady Dora Mae sets modest fractions
Shady Bay's tongue-tie first time suggests connections seeking improvement after recent disappointing runs

races.name: £9 Racedays At Nottingham Racecourse Handicap

runners_data.name: Leadenhall
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist dropping 6lbs from last winning mark but faces severe tactical disadvantage with five other hold-up horses creating traffic issues.
runners_data.comment: On a good mark; two encouraging runs this year and he now drops in class
runners_data.spotlight: 6lb lower than when winning at Haydock last summer (1m, good to firm); two creditable runs in defeat this season and he now drops in class.

runners_data.name: Great Blasket
runners_data.note: Course and distance winner whose hold-up style is compromised by the race shape, though his proven ability at this track keeps him competitive.
runners_data.comment: C&D winner who is on a good mark; sharper for latest run; one to consider
runners_data.spotlight: C&D winner; 5lb lower than for his last success; ran a solid race on this month's return to turf at Windsor; one to consider.

runners_data.name: Stardancer
runners_data.note: Long absence and hold-up style make her vulnerable in a race lacking pace, despite showing promise in handicap debut last summer.
runners_data.spotlight: Promise in AW novices and again when third of ten at Doncaster on her handicap debut last June (7f, good); disappointed at Yarmouth the following month and absent since; has undergone wind surgery during his layoff; drops in class, up in trip and tongue tied for his return; still has potential.

runners_data.name: The Sweet Escape
runners_data.note: Prominent runner perfectly positioned to track the lone leader, with recent C&D victory proving her effectiveness at this level.
runners_data.comment: C&D win last month; went close at Leicester on penultimate start; needs more in this grade
runners_data.spotlight: Saw off 14 rivals when narrowly winning over C&D last month (Class 6); also went close in a Class 6 at Leicester this month but either side of that he was unplaced in Class 5 events; others preferred for the win.

runners_data.name: Prodigal Son
runners_data.note: Lone front runner wearing effective blinkers who can control the race from pillar to post without meaningful early pressure.
runners_data.comment: 2 good runs in blinkers this year (1m/1m2f, both firm ground); return to 1m a plus; chance
runners_data.spotlight: Blinkers have helped him this spring, seeing off five rivals at Bath (1m, firm) last month and then finishing close up in third back at Bath (1m2f, firm) 19 days ago; returning to a mile can help and Mason Paetel's claim is a useful one.

runners_data.name: Penelope Valentine
runners_data.note: AW winner whose turf effectiveness remains unproven, complicated further by hold-up style in a pace-lacking race.
runners_data.comment: Better on AW to this point; returns to turf off a tough-enough mark
runners_data.spotlight: Won two AW handicaps (7f/8.6f) over the winter; the handicapper may have caught up now and she still has to prove she can be as effective on turf.

runners_data.name: Bass Player
runners_data.note: Tongue tie returns but his hold-up style faces the same tactical disadvantage as the majority of this field.
runners_data.comment: Two disappointing runs this year either side of a wind op; tongue tie returns; risky
runners_data.spotlight: Ended 2025 with two good runs but he has been well short of that level in two runs this year, a wind op before the latest making no difference; tongue tie returns; risky despite his reduced mark.

races.paceDynamic: Prodigal Son is the sole confirmed front runner and will take the field along at a sustainable gallop from the outset. With The Sweet Escape likely to sit prominently behind him and the remaining five all hold-up types, there will be minimal early pressure on the leader. This creates a tempo where Prodigal Son can dictate terms through steady fractions before the pack unleashes late. The lack of pace pressure strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will engulf the large hold-up contingent in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Prodigal Son faces no early pressure and maintains his advantage.
scenarios.body: The leader controls every call while the hold-up horses get bottled up behind a wall of horses turning for home. His recent Bath wins in blinkers prove he can sustain a gallop when allowed easy fractions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If The Sweet Escape can stalk Prodigal Son and time her challenge perfectly.
scenarios.body: She avoids the inevitable traffic chaos while sitting in the ideal stalking position behind the leader. Her recent C&D win shows she can finish strongly when getting a good trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-up Hero Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and one hold-up horse finds clear daylight.
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace allows a patient ride to work but requires significant luck in running. Leadenhall's class edge could tell if he gets a clear passage late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If Prodigal Son stops quickly and allows multiple hold-up horses to challenge.
scenarios.body: The leader's stamina gives way suddenly, creating a bunched finish where any of the hold-up horses could prevail. This scenario requires both pace collapse and clean passages for the back markers.

watchPoints.text: Prodigal Son breaking slowly would completely alter the race dynamics as no other confirmed leader exists in this field.
Traffic problems developing on the turn for home as six hold-up horses converge simultaneously behind the leaders.
The Sweet Escape getting too keen early and losing her tactical advantage of sitting behind the uncontested leader.
How aggressively Mason Paetel rides Prodigal Son with his 5lb claim potentially affecting the leader's tempo judgment.
Whether any of the hold-up horses attempt to race more prominently than their usual style suggests to avoid traffic issues.
